This is how you sell digital downloads directly to customers using Bitcoin or any of 300+ cryptocurrencies. No middlemen. No subscriptions. No platform dependence. Your store runs on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Backend logic executes via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Orders store in Supabase or Google Sheets. Files deliver instantly via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments verify automatically on-chain with NOWPayments. You own the stack. You control the flow. This is not a patch. It’s a system. Built for creators who choose ownership over renting.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-3. content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

This is a complete commerce stack designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. It’s not a plugin or a third-party service. It’s a combination of free and paid tools assembled into a fully operational store. The core principle is infrastructure sovereignty. You own every component. You deploy it. You control it. No platform can shut you down. No subscription can expire. The stack handles three critical functions: payment processing, order fulfillment, and data storage. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a flat 0.5% fee. Order fulfillment is automated—the moment payment confirms on-chain, the product delivers to the customer’s email or download link. Data storage is handled by Supabase or Google Sheets, depending on the stack you choose. This architecture is built to withstand the specific challenges creators in Kenya and similar regions face: payment rejection, currency instability, and financial isolation. It’s not a workaround. It’s a permanent solution.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack operates in layers. The frontend is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally distributed. The backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These tools handle order processing, payment verification, and file delivery. When a customer purchases a product, the payment is sent to NOWPayments. NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and sends a webhook to your backend. The backend then retrieves the product file from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and sends a secure download link to the customer’s email. The entire process is automated and instantaneous. There’s no manual intervention required. The stack is designed to be lightweight and scalable. It uses serverless architecture, so you only pay for what you use. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script are free up to generous usage limits. Supabase and Google Sheets provide scalable storage for orders and customer data. The system is modular—you can swap components as your needs evolve. This is how you build a store that grows with you, not one that locks you in.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is built for digital creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. If you’re in Kenya, Ghana, Nigeria, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, the Philippines, or any region where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted, this is for you. You’re not a victim of circumstance. You’re a creator who chose better architecture. You understand that renting platforms is a temporary solution. Owning your infrastructure is permanent. This stack is also for creators who value data ownership. When you use conventional platforms, they own your customer data. With this system, you control every byte. You decide how to use it, where to store it, and who can access it. This is not just about selling products. It’s about building a business that can’t be taken away. It’s about operating on your terms, in your currency, on your infrastructure.
This stack is built for creators who choose ownership over renting.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack consists of five core components: hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. Hosting is handled by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally distributed. Backend logic is executed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These tools process orders, verify payments, and deliver files. Order storage is managed by Supabase or Google Sheets. Supabase is a serverless PostgreSQL database, while Google Sheets is a familiar spreadsheet interface. File delivery is handled by Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Both services provide secure, fast, and affordable storage for your digital products. Payment processing is done by NOWPayments. It supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, charges a flat 0.5% fee, and requires no KYC. The moment a payment confirms on-chain, NOWPayments sends a webhook to your backend, triggering automatic delivery. These components are integrated into a seamless workflow. The customer places an order, pays with crypto, and receives the product instantly. You retain full control over every step. No platform fees. No data harvesting. Just direct commerce.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing the stack that fits your needs. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys in 48 hours and includes GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys in 48 hours and includes Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. If you prefer to build it yourself, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all six blueprints, full source code, and a scaling playbook. Once you’ve chosen your stack, follow the deployment guide. It walks you through every step: setting up hosting, configuring backend logic, integrating NOWPayments, and loading your products. The guide is written in plain language, with no technical jargon. You don’t need to be a developer to deploy this. You need to follow instructions. After deployment, you own the stack. COREMERCH has no access. No platform dependence. No subscriptions. Lifetime access. This is how you build a store that can’t be shut down. This is how you sell digital products on your terms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

This system allows digital creators to sell ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products using Bitcoin or any of 300+ cryptocurrencies. It uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Payments are processed by NOWPayments, which verifies transactions on-chain and triggers automatic product delivery. The stack is designed to be sovereign—you own every component and control every step. It’s built for creators in regions where traditional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable, providing a permanent solution to financial isolation.
No platform dependence. No subscriptions. Lifetime access.

If you’re ready to deploy this system today, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all six blueprints, full source code, and a scaling playbook. It’s everything you need to build and own your sovereign commerce infrastructure. No platform dependence. No subscriptions. Lifetime access. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for managed deployment, or Complete Builder Kit ($197) for DIY. 2. Follow the deployment guide to set up hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 3. Configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 4. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 5. Load your digital products into Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6. Test the entire flow end-to-end to ensure automatic delivery works. 7. Launch your store and start selling directly to customers.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The deployment guides are written in plain language, with no technical jargon. You don’t need to be a developer to follow the instructions and deploy your store.
What cryptocurrencies can my customers use to pay?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Coin, Solana, and TRON. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON—under $0.10 per transaction.
Do I need to pay any ongoing fees after deployment?
No. The stack uses free tools for hosting, backend logic, and storage. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction charge. There are no subscriptions or platform fees.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?
Yes. The architecture is modular and serverless. You can swap components as your needs evolve. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook to guide you.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments operates on a decentralized network, so downtime is rare. However, since you own the stack, you can integrate additional payment processors if needed.
